comparison.objective: Lay two cables into an energy chain in order and snap every crossbar shut; candidate tunes a rigid damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable routing, crossing avoidance, and repeated latch closure versus small fastener engagement and response-guided rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Both cables correctly ordered inside all links, every crossbar latched, ends extended, and hands released; candidate checks impact performance.
comparison.reason: Cable management and repeated snap-latching are not duplicated by the candidate.
